chapter: Tulane Brass Band and bass drum
title: What the Tulane band played and who was in it
summary: The Tulane band was unrelated to the Tulane Club though it played for it; it did funerals, parades and dances with mostly uptown players.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals

What kind of jobs? They play all kinds of jobs. Well they'd play funerals, parades? Funerals, parades, dance, and then. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
